title: Choose which courses a school can use

steps.say: **Courses** sets what this school or group is allowed to learn. Tapping it opens the picker and changes nothing until you save.
Choose the whole catalogue for a school that is paid up, or search out the one or two courses a trial should carry. Everyone below this node inherits whatever you save.
steps.terminal: That's a school's reading list set from one place — the server works the trial dates out on save. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
